    - list:

      - listitem: The counts under the grid are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) that show only one state

    - list:

      - listitem: Retrying cells breathe in amber; done and failed cells pop once when they land
      - listitem: The details window opens with a soft scale and fade from its cell
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears at once

      - listitem: Under 520px the cells get smaller and the numbers move to a line of their own

    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass every task every time something changes – ids keep cells in place, and a cell animates when its status changes
      - listitem: start and end are ms from the job's start, not timestamps
      - listitem: The time left needs at least three finished tasks; pass workers for an honest estimate
      - listitem: A retried task keeps its id – raise attempts and set status back to running
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-fogc, e.g. --ui-fogc-done-bg / --ui-fogc-done-edge
